title: Loop pair — circulation under the free wave map, beside a zero-circulation control
description: A coherent flux-cell ring at x = 8 and its sign-scrambled control at x = 24, on the periodic free wave map, authored for the default 33 lattice. The two rings have the same pointwise |J|; only the coherent one carries circulation. The coherent ring's circulation reverses sign between ticks 2 and 3. The control reads zero through tick 4 and stays below 0.5% of the coherent ring's starting value through tick 8; after that the coherent ring's waves have reached it and the two are no longer independent. All initial data is [IMPOSED]. View the mid-plane flux slice with the curlJ channel.
